s1.syndrome_frame: Cardiac dysfunction with possible infiltrative or obstructive process in the setting of a history of malignancy
salient_findings: Prolonged P-wave duration and abnormal P wave morphology on ECG
Diffuse medium masses in the right atrium on echocardiogram
key_facts: Patient is in their 70s
History of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
Treated with 8 courses of chemotherapy 4 years ago
No history of structural heart disease or hypertension
Blood pressure is 96/54 mm Hg
Heart rate is 56 bpm
Serum troponin I is 0.04 ng/mL
NT-proBNP is 3896.83 pg/mL
ECG shows prolonged P-wave duration and abnormal P wave morphology
Transthoracic echocardiogram reveals diffuse medium masses in the right atrium
PET-CT scan shows increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium

shortlist.label: Cardiac lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and evidence of masses in the right atrium

shortlist.label: Secondary cardiac tumor
shortlist.why_kept: History of malignancy and imaging findings suggestive of tumor involvement

shortlist.label: Lymphomatous pericarditis
shortlist.why_kept: History of lymphoma and evidence of pericardial involvement on PET-CT scan

shortlist.label: Right atrial myxoma
shortlist.why_kept: Imaging findings of a mass in the right atrium, although less likely given the patient's history

shortlist.label: Primary cardiac lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Evidence of cardiac involvement and history of lymphoma, although primary cardiac lymphoma is rare

raw.rationale: The patient's history of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, combined with the presence of diffuse medium masses in the right atrium on echocardiogram and increased metabolic activity on PET-CT scan, strongly suggests cardiac involvement of the lymphoma.

rejected.label: Secondary cardiac tumor
rejected.why: While possible, the presence of lymphoma masses in the right atrium and increased metabolic activity suggests a primary cardiac lymphoma or direct cardiac involvement of the known lymphoma rather than a secondary tumor.

rejected.label: Lymphomatous pericarditis
rejected.why: The findings are more suggestive of intracardiac masses rather than pericardial involvement alone.

rejected.label: Right atrial myxoma
rejected.why: The patient's history of lymphoma and the characteristics of the masses and metabolic activity are not typical for a myxoma.

rejected.label: Primary cardiac lymphoma
rejected.why: Given the patient's known history of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, it is more likely that the cardiac involvement is secondary to the known lymphoma rather than a primary cardiac lymphoma.
